map: Warehouse 2 (Tacticals match map, GTA-style freight warehouse), brief briefs/map-warehouse2.md
for: roblox-modeler (art/warehouse2/, notes/warehouse2_props.md). Until a piece lands, fix/map_warehouse2.lua builds a Part stand-in at the exact size, tagged Warehouse2Standin (swap list: notes/warehouse2_build.md)
rules: Visual meshes never collide (CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch off): collision stays the invisible COLP_* box of the same size. Cover sizes are fixed by the gameplay layer: a mesh may be up to 0.1 smaller than its box on any side, never bigger. Pivot = bottom centre. Grounded / GTA look: worn, real materials, no neon, no screens, no blue trims, no yellow (hazard = black/cream).
asset_library_start: 02 Modeling/Asset Library: start from the crate / pallet / barrier entries where they exist; stand-in recipes in fix/map_warehouse2.lua (STANDIN table)

pieces.name: JerseyBarrier
pieces.notes: precast concrete, upright profile (top >= 1.0 wide so the box isn't far off), lifting slots, chipped edges, faint grime

pieces.name: PrecastBlockWall
pieces.notes: interlocking concrete blocks (2 wide x 3 high, each ~5x2.33x3), bay divider

pieces.name: TallCrate
pieces.notes: plywood shipping crate on skids, battens, stencil (art/warehouse2/tex/decals), 2 or 3 variants

pieces.name: PalletStack
pieces.notes: two shrink-wrapped pallet loads stacked (each 5x5x5 incl. pallet), cardboard / sacks under wrap

pieces.name: BoxTrailer
pieces.view_distance: 0-60 (from the hall through the door up to 130)
pieces.notes: 40 ft dry van on landing legs, side skirts down to 0.6 so nothing is seen under it, olive stripe livery, two colourways

pieces.name: Container20
pieces.notes: 20 ft ISO container, corrugated sides, door end, two colours (rust red-brown, grey-green)

pieces.name: HighBayLamp
pieces.notes: aluminium bell + driver box + drop rod; lens disc is the light source (SpotLight down) | ROUND 6: RETIRED - the hall now uses LightBar + SteelLightBeam (Edward: the old Warehouse's steel-beam lights).

pieces.name: RollUpDoor
pieces.notes: galvanised slat curtain rolled up in a drum housing, side guides, bottom bar; opening 20 x 14 | ROUND 6: the doors are SHUT in play and roll up by script: the curtain is a gameplay Part (Shutter) the script shrinks from the bottom, so model only the frame (jambs, head, drum hood, guides) as a mesh; the curtain look stays a Part + slat SurfaceGui (or a baked slat texture that tiles vertically on that Part).

pieces.name: FencePanelScreened
pieces.notes: steel palisade with dark-green privacy mesh, barbed wire on top

pieces.name: Bollard
pieces.role: dressing at the yard side of each door (no collision)
pieces.notes: steel pipe, olive paint, cream reflective band

pieces.name: ElectricalCabinet
pieces.notes: grey steel cabinet with conduit up the wall

pieces.name: OilDrum
pieces.notes: black / olive drums, NOT red (red = the shootable fire barrels)

pieces.name: LightBar
pieces.role: the hall's light (round 6): long LED bar under a steel beam, switched on
pieces.notes: steel housing, two clamps, a recessed warm-white lens (the lens stays a Neon part in Studio so it glows), cable drop optional; keep the lens face flat and 0.1 below the housing

pieces.name: SteelLightBeam
pieces.role: I-beam spanning the hall wall to wall at 13-14.3, carries 2 LightBars, hung on rods from the purlins
pieces.notes: dark painted steel (46,48,48), end plates on the cladding, hanger clips; one mesh + instances

pieces.name: CorrugatedCladdingPanel
pieces.role: MATERIAL (round 6): replaces the removed WH2_Corrugated MaterialVariant on the side / end wall cladding above the blockwork
pieces.notes: real trapezoidal ribs every ~0.9 stud modelled or baked (normal + AO) in Blender, galvanised (172,174,172), light streak grime baked; panel seams every 8 studs; no tiling Studio variant (Edward: tiling textures look fake)

pieces.name: CorrugatedRoofSheet
pieces.role: MATERIAL (round 6): the pitched roof sheets between the skylight strips (default Metal reads flat from below)
pieces.notes: ribs running eave to ridge, baked AO in the troughs so the underside reads corrugated under the light bars

pieces.name: BlockworkPanel
pieces.role: MATERIAL (round 6): the 0-11.2 blockwork band (was the WH2_Block variant)
pieces.notes: 400x200 block joints baked into one panel texture (not a tiling variant), dark kick band and the charcoal stripe painted in; light (178,175,168)

frame_kit_in_parts: steel portal frames (I-section from 3 Parts), purlins, roof sheets, skylights, cladding, plinth, floor paint and stains stay Studio Parts + own textures (parts-first style)
round6: 2026-10-27 map builder: lamps -> LightBar + SteelLightBeam; the five WH2_* MaterialVariants removed, so the cladding, roof sheets and blockwork need Blender-baked panels (CorrugatedCladdingPanel, CorrugatedRoofSheet, BlockworkPanel) if the render reads flat; olive only on two crates (the modeler's round 6 keeps olive to the long crate and the ammo can: fine)
